<analysis>
The task is a fully-confirmed BGS build brief: a cute cat-catching-fish web game (小猫接鱼), React + Canvas 2D, landscape, Web, touch/keyboard/mouse, Chinese UI, 60-second loop, 3 fish types, 2 trash types, scoring/settlement, warm cheerful art, BGM+SFX. I've been executing autonomously across the standard eight-domain workflow.

Completed: eight design docs in docs/; two AI reference boards (ui-board 1536x1024 4 credits kittyfish-uiboard-v1, scene-board 1536x1024 4 credits kittyfish-sceneboard-v1); production background (kittyfish-bg-v2 after v1 502/409 unknown receipt — v1 outcome remains unknown/unresolved for billing, 4 credits, diagnosticId 92871664...; v2 settled 4 credits); transparent sprite sheet (kittyfish-sprites-v2 settled 3 credits after v1 503/502 unknown, diagnosticId 9a568f8d...). Sprites were alpha-measured via custom Python (6 clean components), cropped/resized with media.mjs into assets/source/frames/, packed to assets/runtime/sprites.png + sprites.atlas.json (830×656, 6 frames, edge-copy linear padding). bg copied to assets/runtime/bg.png. 12 WAVs rendered via resources.mjs audio recipe into assets/runtime/audio/ (all valid, no clipping). All 14 resources registered into assets/asset-manifest.json after several schema corrections.

Content package: rewrote content/ as beegame-content-package.v2 + beegame-content.v1 scene/UI docs. check-content --current now valid: true. --design-layouts valid with targetViewports [[1280,720],[1920,1080]] (smaller hosts letterboxed at runtime). --scene-layouts valid. Index revisions last updated to documentRevision starting 9ae049f46b79 — BUT this was computed BEFORE the later zones edit (catchLine y=560, basketHalfWidth=44, catHome 640,620, catDrawnSize 153×190), so documentRevision is stale and must be regenerated + index updated + --current re-run.

Code written: package.json (react19, vite5), vite.config.js (base './'), index.html, src/game/config.js (later edited: CAT 153×190, CATCH fallback y560/hw44, ITEM_DRAW_H), src/game/input.js, src/game/content-client.js, src/game/audio.js, src/game/engine.js (just written — has potential issues: unused CATCH import-ish fine; pop animation y duplicated; cat bottom=706 fixed; debugFastForward; not yet browser-tested). STILL MISSING: src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx, src/styles.css, all src/components/* (GameCanvas, Hud, Menu, PauseDialog, ResultScreen, Countdown, OrientationGate), the custom Vite plugin needed to copy assets/runtime (and content/ and assets/asset-manifest.json + assets/manifest/**) into dist since assets/ is outside public/ and content/ needs serving too. bun install not yet run. No build, no preview run, no measure evidence yet.

Key constraint: engine consumes content zones but config.js fallback values were also changed; scene JSON is authoritative. Atlas frame IDs: cat-basket, fish-yellow, fish-blue, fish-gold, trash-can, trash-boot. Audio IDs as registered. Need to verify engine catches work visually (catchLine 560 vs cat drawn y, basket half width 44 may be narrow vs visual basket).
</analysis>

<summary>
1. Current work and constraints:
Active request: autonomously build the confirmed game 「小猫接鱼」 in the current empty BGS project (Web/React, Cartoon 2D, Landscape, Touch+Keyboard/mouse, Chinese). Scope: one complete playable version — 1 cat, 3 fish (小黄鱼+10, 蓝大鱼+20, 金鱼+50), 2 trash (易拉罐−10/1.5s slow, 烂靴子−20/2.5s slow), one 60s level, scoring+combo+settlement+bonus by catch rate, high score, warm BGM + full SFX. Must do visual reference boards (structured uiReference/ui-board-plan) BEFORE bulk art, then implement and run actual runtime/browser checks in the same assignment; don't precommit image counts or stop at art handoff. Preserve user choices; ask only on missing material authorization; never claim unperformed checks/acceptance. Build authorization came from the confirmed goal itself; AI image usage was self-directed under "cost before generate; quote read-only; keep stable requestId; opening bridge doesn't charge." respond in Chinese.

2. Unresolved work:
- Billing unknowns (do NOT assume charged/free; receipts only say promptRecord recorded, outcome unknown): kittyfish-bg-v1 (502 then 409 replayed, never delivered; diagnosticId 92871664-a257-4d46-9473-eade1d5b70d0) and kittyfish-sprites-v1 (503 then 502; diagnosticId 9a568f8d-27ec-4ab0-84a3-51b95cbc463e). Both superseded by successful v2 generations.
- content/index.json documentRevision is STALE: last value 9ae049f46b79… was derived before the scene zones edit. Must rerun `check-content.mjs --package-metadata content/scenes/level1.json content/ui/*.json` (5 ui files), write new documentRevision/assetManifestRevision into content/index.json, then rerun `--current`.
- Application code remaining: src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx (state machine boot→menu→countdown→playing→paused→result), src/styles.css, src/components/ (GameCanvas, Hud, Menu, PauseDialog, ResultScreen, Countdown, OrientationGate); UI must consume saved content/ui/*.json geometry (custom DOM renderer; shared consumer optional) and actions game.start/pause/resume/restart/home, ui.toggle-mute; bindings score/time/comboLabel/slowdown/highscore/caught/golden/missed/trashHits/bonus/bonusLabel/isRecord/count.
- Build plumbing: `bun install` not run; need Vite plugin/config so dist contains content/, assets/asset-manifest.json, assets/manifest/** (resource modules + requirements), assets/runtime/** (measure replaces only dist; content/assets currently outside public/). base './' already set.
- engine.js is written but untested in browser; verify catch feel (catchLine y=560, basketHalfWidth=44, cat bottom 706, h=190), gold glow, pop arc, slowdown, 60s finish, result stats.
- No build/smoke/preview/measure/audio-probe evidence yet; deliveryEligible currently false.

3. Saved work and evidence:
- docs/: GDD.md, TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md, ART_DIRECTION.md, AUDIO_DESIGN.md, UI_UX_SPEC.md, LEVEL_SCENE_DESIGN.md, BALANCE_DESIGN.md, ASSET_PLAN.md.
- assets/visual/ui-board.png (4cr, visually inspected: 4 screens correct, warm consistent; AI microtext garbled — runtime text is DOM), assets/visual/scene-board.png (4cr, inspected: kitchen+cat+3 fish+can+boot consistent).
- assets/source/bg-kitchen.png (bg-v2, 4cr settled, inspected: no characters/UI, clean center), assets/source/sprites-raw.png 1024² transparent (sprites-v2, 3cr settled; alpha confirmed via Python: 67.6% transparent, 6 components clean incl. gold sparkles in same cell), assets/source/frames/{cat-basket,fish-yellow,fish-blue,fish-gold,trash-can,trash-boot}.png.
- assets/runtime/: bg.png (1536×1024), sprites.png (830×656) + sprites.atlas.json frames cat-basket(332×412), fish-yellow(225×154), fish-blue(267×194), fish-gold(231×204), trash-can(163×194), trash-boot(192×240); atlas visually inspected clean. audio/bgm-kitchen.wav (16s loop) + 11 sfx wav (catch/golden/trash/miss/dodge/count/go/end/button/pause/record), 44.1k stereo, peaks 0.099–0.317 no clipping.
- assets/asset-manifest.json + assets/manifest/ created via resources.mjs register (valid); resources: img/background-kitchen, atlas/sprites, audio/bgm-kitchen, 11 sfx; requirements req/background-kitchen, req/sprite-atlas, req/audio-bgm, req/audio-sfx. Note: registrar rejected source objects (only web provenance accepted) and required selection_reason as array; acquisition_profile needed dimensions ['2D'], asset_kinds image/sprite-atlas/audio-clip.
- content/index.json (v2 pkg, id kitty-fish-catch-v1, entryScene scene-level1) + scenes/level1.json (camera letterbox, screen-canvas+background image w/ rect-transform+canvas-renderer, gameplay-zones behavior kittyfish-zones) + ui/{menu,hud,countdown,pause,result}.json. Verified valid by --current and --design-layouts/--scene-layouts at 1280×720 (pre-zones-edit revisions).
- src/game/: config.js (all tunables; functions spawnInterval 1.05→0.52s, fallSpeed 200→340, trashChance 0→0.30, fishKind weights, bonusForCatchRate), input.js (keyboard/pointer, touch-action), content-client.js (fetch index+docs+manifest modules, resolves bg/atlas/audio via root_path, extracts zones), audio.js (AudioManager, localStorage mute key kitty-fish-muted-v1, 8-voice pool), engine.js (fixed 1/120 step, canvas 1280×720×dpr, HUD callback, onFinish with bonus).
- Helper scripts live in .beegame/tmp/2c1a725034f7ccfca9da028e/ (requests, recipes, alpha_bounds.py, components.py, register.json, media json). High score key: kitty-fish-highscore-v1.

4. Where to continue:
Next precise step: write the React layer. Create src/main.jsx + src/App.jsx that calls loadGameContent('.') from src/game/content-client.js, instantiates AudioManager and GameEngine with InputController, and renders DOM UI from content/ui/*.json node geometry (absolute positioned 1280×720 #logical-root scaled/letterboxed per TECHNICAL_DESIGN §3), with a CSS OrientationGate for portrait. Implement countdown (3-2-1 using sfx-count/sfx-go), HUD loop via engine.onHud, pause on Esc/button/blur, result via onFinish (bonus, high score, sfx-record when new), mute toggle, BGM start on 开始游戏 click (unlock gesture), BGM 40% on result. Then add a Vite plugin to copy content/, assets/runtime, assets/asset-manifest.json and assets/manifest into dist; run `bun install` and `bun run build`. After code, FIRST regenerate content index revisions (zones edit) and revalidate. Then run measure.mjs --artifact dist with --request stable id plus consumption probes (ui-data-consumption on menu/result with click #start; scene-data-consumption on background node; audio-data-consumption for BGM play/stop; coordinateRoot "#logical-root"), and preview.mjs --run an interaction test (start→countdown→fast game via engine.debugFastForward or scripted input→assert result screen) with screenshots at 1280×720 and a portrait viewport. Inspect receipts with --inspect; do not rerun paid image generation. Adjust catch geometry only after observing actual gameplay.
</summary>
